import 'package:adele_ui/capability_bridge.dart';
import 'package:adele_ui/directory_picker_bridge.dart';
import 'package:adele_ui/environment_access_bridge.dart';
import 'package:adele_ui/environment_capability_bridge.dart';
import 'package:adele_ui/main_content_bridge.dart';
import 'package:adele_ui/owning_backend_bridge.dart';
import 'package:adele_ui/session_execution_bridge.dart';
import 'package:session_command_probe/contract.dart';

int calls = 0;

void local(String sessionId) {
  calls++;
  if (calls != 1 || !sessionId.startsWith('session-')) {
    throw StateError('Expected a fresh runtime and captured Session identity.');
  }
}

void independent() {}

CapabilityProbeServiceClient client() => CapabilityProbeServiceClient(
  OwningBackendRequestChannel(capabilityProbeServiceId),
);

void checkValue(ProbeValue value, String text) {
  if (value.provider != 'OWNER' ||
      value.configuration != 'default' ||
      value.text != text) {
    throw StateError('Generated value reached the wrong owner or Session.');
  }
}

Future<void> unary(String sessionId) async {
  final value = await client().read(sessionId);
  checkValue(value, sessionId);
}

Future<void> captured(String sessionId) async {
  final service = client();
  checkValue(await service.read('held'), 'held');
  checkValue(await service.read(sessionId), sessionId);
}

Future<void> bounded(String sessionId) => StreamOperation().bounded(sessionId);
Future<void> paused(String sessionId) => StreamOperation().paused(sessionId);
Future<void> observing(String sessionId) =>
    StreamOperation().observing(sessionId);

class StreamOperation {
  final values = <String>[];
  bool failed = false;
  bool delivered = false;
  dynamic subscription;

  Future<void> bounded(String sessionId) async {
    subscription = client()
        .watch('bounded')
        .listen(
          (ProbeValue value) {
            checkValue(value, value.sequence == 1 ? 'first' : 'last');
            values.add('${value.sequence}:${value.text}');
          },
          onError: (Object error) {
            failed = true;
          },
          onDone: () {
            client().read('bounded-done');
          },
        );
    await client().read('held');
    if (failed || values.join(',') != '1:first,2:last') {
      throw StateError('Generated stream was incomplete or out of order.');
    }
    await unary(sessionId);
  }

  Future<void> paused(String sessionId) async {
    subscription = client()
        .watch('gated')
        .listen(
          (ProbeValue value) {
            delivered = true;
            checkValue(value, 'queued');
            client().read('delivered');
          },
          onError: (Object error) {
            failed = true;
          },
        );
    subscription.pause();
    await client().read('held');
    if (delivered) throw StateError('A paused subscription delivered an item.');
    subscription.resume();
    await client().read('held-completion');
    await subscription.cancel();
    if (failed || !delivered) throw StateError('Observation unavailable.');
    await unary(sessionId);
  }

  Future<void> observing(String sessionId) async {
    subscription = client()
        .watch('gated')
        .listen(
          (ProbeValue value) {
            throw StateError('Unexpected observation after retirement.');
          },
          onError: (Object error) {
            failed = true;
          },
        );
    await client().read('held-observation');
    if (failed) throw StateError('Observation unavailable.');
    await unary(sessionId);
  }
}

Future<void> undeclared(String sessionId) async {
  await requestOwningBackend(
    'test.capability.private',
    'test.capability.probe.read',
    <String, dynamic>{'scope': sessionId},
  );
}

Future<void> foreign(String sessionId) async {
  await requestOwningBackend(
    'test.foreign.service',
    'test.capability.probe.read',
    <String, dynamic>{'scope': sessionId, 'pluginId': 'test.session.foreign'},
  );
}

Future<void> backendFailure(String sessionId) async {
  final result = await settleOwningBackendOperation(client().read('fail'));
  if (result[0] != false || result[1] != null) {
    throw StateError('Backend failure escaped safe settlement.');
  }
}

Future<void> picker(String sessionId) async {
  await pickDirectory();
}

void panes(String sessionId) {
  openMainContentPane(sessionId, 'Forbidden', true);
}

void capabilities(String sessionId) {
  discoverCapabilityProviders('test.capability.read', 1);
}

Future<void> environmentRead(String sessionId) async {
  await readEnvironmentTextFile('private.txt');
}

Future<void> environmentWrite(String sessionId) async {
  await replaceEnvironmentTextFile('private.txt', 'forbidden', 'revision');
}

Future<void> environmentProcess(String sessionId) async {
  await resolveEnvironmentBufferedProcessCapabilityProvider(
    'test.capability.read',
    1,
    capabilityProbeServiceId,
    null,
  );
}

Future<void> execution(String sessionId) async {
  await startSessionRun();
}

void approval(String sessionId) {
  buildSessionExecutionStatus();
}

int malformed(String sessionId) => 42;

Future<int> malformedAsync(String sessionId) async => 42;

void wrongArgument(int sessionId) {
  if (sessionId.isEven)
    throw StateError('An integer is not a Session identity.');
}

Future<void> failure(String sessionId) async {
  throw StateError('private session-command diagnostic');
}
